name: File manager
description: A folder of the shop's own pictures and files with a permanent public link each: icons and pictures for blocks, photos for a marketplace feed, a price list to hand out. Folders, uploading many at once, previews, and copying the links of several files in one go.

settings.default: jpg, jpeg, png, webp, gif, avif, svg, ico, pdf
settings.label: Types of files accepted
settings.help: Extensions, comma separated. The type is read from the file itself, not from its name. An SVG is rebuilt from what draws and nothing else; programs and web pages are never accepted, whatever is listed here.

settings.label: Largest file, MB
settings.help: The server's own upload limit may be lower; then that one decides.

settings.label: Names of stored files
settings.help: What the file's link ends in: red-boot.jpg or k3f9x2qa7m1b.jpg. New uploads only — a link once handed out never changes, not even when the file is renamed or moved to another folder.

settings.label: Shrink photos larger than, px
settings.help: The longer side of a JPEG, PNG or WebP over this is brought down to it on upload. 0 = keep every file exactly as uploaded.
